I'll write Python code to sort the letters of 'gnrbozhhvagpje' alphabetically.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
# Sort the letters of the string alphabetically
string = 'gnrbozhhvagpje'
sorted_string = ''.join(sorted(string))
print(f"Original string: {string}")

EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
